name: Lipoprotein metabolism with vitamin E and phytosterol absorption
rationale: All members concern dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly, remodeling and clearance; unlike the confusables, the theme adds vitamin E transport/metabolism and ABCG5/ABCG8 sitosterolemia (intestinal sterol efflux) and lacks HDL assembly/cholesterol efflux.

core: E2F G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex activation
name: Core E2F G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex activation
rationale: Members share E2F-driven G1/S transcription with pre-RC/ORC-CDC6 activation and replication-initiation checkpoints; it is the compact core lacking the superset's ORC assembly, DNA unwinding, E2F6 and generic cell-cycle/proliferation modules.

qualifier: origin assembly through DNA unwinding, proliferation modules
name: Proliferative E2F cell cycle program from origin assembly to unwinding
rationale: Members span E2F target transcription and DNA replication initiation; beyond its core subset it adds ORC assembly, DNA unwinding, E2F6 regulation, G1/S and G2/M promotion and generic proliferation modules, and lacks the DREAM/p107/p130 repression of a confusable.

core: Endothelial inflammatory activation and vascular wound healing
name: Endothelial inflammatory activation and vascular wound healing
rationale: All members concern endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, endothelial proliferation/apoptosis and vessel repair/remodeling; this is the compact core lacking the superset's macrophage, synoviocyte and MMP terms and the confusables' smooth-muscle and VEGF/FGF angiogenesis focus.

name: Endothelial activation plus synoviocyte proliferation and macrophage survival
rationale: Members share endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular wound healing, and what distinguishes the theme from its core subset is synoviocyte proliferation, macrophage anti-apoptosis and MMP secretion control, absent from the smooth-muscle and angiogenesis confusables.

name: Keratinocyte, hair, tooth and gland ectodermal organogenesis
rationale: Members cover epidermal keratinocyte differentiation/cornification and ectodermal organs (hair follicle, tooth/odontoblast, nail, mammary, sebaceous, taste papilla); compact core lacking the superset's NF-kappaB ectodermal dysplasia and dentinogenesis terms and the confusables' melanocyte/MITF pigmentation.

name: Ectodermal organogenesis with NF-kappaB ectodermal dysplasia and dentinogenesis
rationale: Members share epidermal keratinization and ectodermal appendage development; beyond its core subset the theme adds IKBKG/IkBA anhidrotic ectodermal dysplasia, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption, and lacks the confusables' melanocyte/MITF and intestinal epithelium programs.

name: Mesenchymal and epithelial proliferation in lung and salivary budding
rationale: Members share epithelial-mesenchymal signaling controlling epithelial and mesenchymal proliferation in lung and salivary bud branching; the compact core lacks the superset's trachea and lung vasculature terms and the confusables' pneumocyte and prostate terms.

name: Lung and salivary branching with trachea and lung vasculature formation
rationale: Members share epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary branching; beyond its core subset the theme adds trachea formation and cartilage, lung vasculature and dichotomous terminal subdivision, without the confusables' pneumocyte or prostate terms.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to neratinib, afatinib, tesevatinib
rationale: All three members are ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to a specific TKI; the subset is limited to neratinib, afatinib and tesevatinib, lacking the osimertinib, sapitinib and AEE788 members of the larger set.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance including osimertinib, sapitinib, AEE788
rationale: All six members are ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to TKIs; it extends the three-drug subset with osimertinib, sapitinib and AEE788 and lacks the confusables' oncogenic ERBB/FGFR signaling.

name: Estrogen-dependent gene expression and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Members share estrogen/estradiol response and ER/PR signaling; beyond the three-member core it adds estrogen-dependent gene expression (with AP-2 growth factor transcription), and it lacks the confusables' androgen and mammary terms.

qualifier: cellular estrogen response core, no transcription
name: Positive estrogen receptor regulation and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: All three members concern estrogen response, positive regulation of ER signaling and PR signaling; it lacks the superset's estrogen-dependent gene expression and the confusables' androgen and mammary development terms.

name: G-CSF and retinoid signaling in neutrophil lineage commitment
rationale: Members share myeloid progenitor-to-neutrophil differentiation driven by G-CSF and RA/PU.1 networks; compact core lacking the superset's RUNX1/granulopoiesis transcription terms and the confusables' eosinophil, mast cell and M-CSF terms.

name: Transcriptional control of granulopoiesis from HSCs to neutrophils
rationale: Members share G-CSF-driven neutrophil differentiation; beyond its core subset it adds RUNX1 HSC differentiation and transcriptional regulation of granulopoiesis, and lacks the confusables' monocyte/macrophage and GM-CSF terms.

name: Glycerol and fructose metabolism, aquaporin transport, acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members share glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism feeding PA/DAG/TAG synthesis, with fructose metabolism and aquaporin glycerol/urea transport; compact core lacking the superset's lysophospholipid hydrolysis and the confusables' lipid droplet/lipolysis terms.

name: Glycerol metabolism linking acylglycerol synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members share glycerol metabolism, aquaporin glycerol transport and acylglycerol synthesis; beyond its core subset it adds glycerophospholipid catabolism (LPC and LPE hydrolysis), lacking the confusables' endocannabinoid, lipolysis and PC synthesis terms.

qualifier: GH, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormones
name: Body growth control by somatotropic, lactogenic, leptin and thyroid hormones
rationale: Members share GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling and thyroid hormone action regulating organismal growth; compact core lacking the superset's amino acid transport and lifespan terms and the confusables' steroid and IL-6-family terms.

qualifier: lifespan and large neutral amino acid transport
name: Endocrine growth axis, lifespan and large neutral amino acid transport
rationale: Members share GH/prolactin/leptin and thyroid hormone signaling for growth; beyond its core subset the theme adds leucine/isoleucine/phenylalanine transport, GH secretion, growth rate and lifespan determination.

qualifier: ventral spinal motor neuron and interneuron
name: Spinal motor neuron and interneuron specification with hindbrain maturation
rationale: Members share dorsoventral neural tube patterning, spinal motor/interneuron fate and hindbrain/pons development; compact core lacking the superset's cranial nerve, DRG and peripheral neuron terms and the confusables' midbrain dopaminergic and floor plate terms.

core: Brainstem and spinal cord neuron development
name: Brainstem, spinal cord and cranial/peripheral nerve neuron development
rationale: Members share hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification; beyond its core subset the theme adds trigeminal and facial nerve, branchiomotor axon guidance, DRG and peripheral neuron differentiation, without the confusables' enteric or midbrain terms.

name: HSF1 heat and arsenite stress responses with stress granules
rationale: Members share HSF1 heat shock activation/attenuation and stress granule/PML body dynamics with arsenite and PKR stress; compact core lacking the superset's chaperone refolding and mitochondrial UPR and the confusables' ARE-mRNA decay.

name: HSF1-chaperone refolding, mitochondrial UPR and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members share HSF1 heat shock response and stress granules; beyond its core subset the theme adds protein refolding, ER folding, mitochondrial UPR and inclusion body control, lacking the confusables' ER UPR/ISR and chaperonin terms.

qualifier: IL-6, LIF and CNTF via gp130
name: IL-6, LIF and CNTF gp130 signaling to STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members share IL-6-type cytokine (IL-6, LIF, CNTF) receptor signaling to STAT3 and ERK1/2; compact core lacking the superset's IL-11, autocrine/paracrine and STAT inhibition terms and the confusables' IL-27/35 and M-CSF terms.

name: Inflammatory IL-6-family autocrine/paracrine signaling with IL-11 and STAT inhibition
rationale: Members share IL-6/LIF/CNTF signaling to STAT3 and ERK; beyond its core subset the theme adds IL-11 signaling, autocrine/paracrine and lymphocyte inflammatory cytokine output, and negative regulation of STAT phosphorylation.
